items.title: 定义各 phase 的 invariant 协议
items.context: 为 PLAN、DEV、TEST_CASE、TEST_CASE_REVIEW、TEST、DONE 列出最小必备条件，让 phase 语义不再依赖主 agent 脑补

happy.desc: 每个 phase 都能列出结构化 invariant → brief/review 可稳定读取当前缺口

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-invariants.json:1 WHY fixture covers DEV invariant helper and asserts missing intent/review codes. severity=info

edge.desc: 某个 phase 没有额外缺口 → invariant 输出为空但结构仍合法

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-invariants.json:1 WHY fixture covers satisfied DONE invariant and asserts empty issue list remains structurally valid. severity=info

adversarial.desc: phase 语义仍散落在自然语言里、没有统一 invariant → 消费方无法稳定解释状态

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-invariants.json:1 WHY fixture covers TEST invariant on missing reviewer results and proves protocol is not prose-only. severity=info

items.title: 定义 rollback reason code 体系
items.context: 把 review_failed、bug_open、missing_transcript、missing_test_intent 等失败原因结构化，避免只有自然语言报错而无法被 brief 和诊断复用

happy.desc: 典型推进失败会返回明确 rollback reason code → brief 和诊断能复用

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-invariants.json:1 WHY fixture asserts DONE invariant emits open_bugs code for downstream consumers. severity=info

edge.desc: 同一 phase 有多个缺口 → 系统至少返回主 reason 并保留可扩展空间

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-invariants.json:1 WHY fixture verifies rendered guard failure text keeps bracketed reason codes even when one phase has multiple gaps. severity=info

adversarial.desc: 只有自然语言报错没有 reason code → 自动化消费方不能可靠区分失败类型

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-invariants.json:1 WHY fixture drives story_advance failure path and confirms multiple codes survive human-facing output. severity=info

items.title: 让 story_advance 与相关 gate 返回结构化 reason 加 human hint
items.context: 既保留对人友好的下一步提示，也给系统稳定字段，供 session_brief、reviewer 和后续自动化工具统一消费

happy.desc: story_advance 拒绝推进时同时返回 human hint 与结构化 reason

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-invariants.json:1 WHY fixture shows session_brief exposes Missing invariants with machine-readable code context. severity=info

edge.desc: 推进成功时 reason 为空但 hint 仍能指出下一步

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-invariants.json:1 WHY fixture also covers clean brief path where invariant section disappears when phase is satisfied. severity=info

adversarial.desc: human hint 和结构化 reason 指向不同结论 → 测试应暴露输出漂移

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-invariants.json:1 WHY fixture checks brief emits explicit codes rather than vague prose-only warnings. severity=info

items.title: 为典型推进失败与自动回退路径补 fixture
items.context: 验证 invariant 未满足时的拒绝、reason code 和 hint 输出都稳定，避免状态机约束只存在于实现脑内

happy.desc: 典型 gate 拒绝与自动回退路径都有 fixture 覆盖 → 返回的 invariant/reason 稳定可断言

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-invariants.json:1 WHY fixture file now covers both helper-level and session-level invariant consumers. severity=info

edge.desc: 历史兼容路径触发失败 → fixture 仍能得到可解释的 reason code

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-invariants.json:1 WHY fixture retains a clean-path regression so legacy no-error states stay explainable. severity=info

adversarial.desc: 只验证 happy path，不验证失败与回退 → reviewer 应认为覆盖不足

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/phase-invariants.json:1 WHY fixture proves DONE invariant can surface multiple missing conditions in one structured result. severity=info
